input_prompt: Macro photograph of a chunky knitted soft sculpture diorama, lit by a low, directional light source from the left that casts long, deep shadows across the textures. Filling the upper background is a dark indigo knitted backdrop. Across the lower third, a chaotic bed of thick looped yarn forms a churning sea. Rising from this base are three massive, conical icebergs constructed of stark white cable-knit yarn, positioned in a rhythmic frontal row: one on the left <iceberg_1>, a slightly taller one on the right <iceberg_2>, and a bulky central peak <iceberg_3>. Clinging to the slopes of the outer icebergs is a rhythmic repetition of tiny, identical pale blue knitted houses. Suspended in the upper frame between the peaks is a slightly curling strip of cream-colored stockinette fabric, bearing thick embroidered text <En_Text_1>. Disrupting the icy white and blue palette, a giant, vibrant magenta knitted whale tail <whale_tail_1> bursts vertically from the center of the teal sea, its thick ribbed surface covered in a halo of stray wool fibers illuminated by the raking light.

boxes.desc: A conical soft sculpture made of stark white, chunky roving yarn in a thick cable-knit pattern. The left side is brightly lit, while the right side falls into deep, fuzzy shadow.
A tall, asymmetrical peak of white cable-knit yarn, featuring a few visibly dropped stitches near the base and slightly uneven tension in the cables.
The largest central iceberg, a bulky mound of white and pale grey ribbed knitting, dominating the midground with thick, vertical columns of stitches.

The exact words "KNITTED ICEBERG VILLAGE" embroidered in thick, raised navy-blue yarn across the cream banner. The lettering is slightly uneven and puckered, conforming to the physical stretch of the knitted fabric beneath it.

A giant whale tail knitted from bright magenta and coral-pink yarn, bursting vertically from the teal sea. It features thick ribs, a slightly asymmetrical fluke, and a fuzzy halo of stray wool fibers caught in the directional light.
